continuity: Choi Minwoo is commanding a group of Hunters in a buried desert shelter; thousands of enemies are approaching, and he chooses to lead the Hunters into the fight rather than wait safely underground.
The Skeleton King is with Choi Minwoo’s group, and the Hunters trust Minwoo to lead them into battle.
Choi Minwoo regards Jin Taekyung as someone who takes responsibility for his actions, even in a crisis.
plot: In a buried Gulf War shelter beneath the desert, Choi Minwoo learns that thousands of enemies are approaching. Though waiting could keep his group safe, he struggles with the prospect of leaving others to face the attackers. The Skeleton King reveals that the Hunters are already ready to fight, trusting Minwoo to make the same choice. Minwoo draws his sword and cuts through the shelter wall to lead them out. As the Skeleton King charges toward the enemy, an unexpected voice says, “Dad’s not sleeping.”

active_continuity: Taekyung’s consciousness is in the realm of immortals while his body sleeps in Murim; he promised Jeok Cheongang he would return.
Jeok Cheongang remains beside Taekyung and intends to protect him on the march to Tianshan.
The coalition army of more than two hundred thousand is crossing the Taklamakan Desert toward Tianshan.
The Grand Mage has been reborn through the Lord of Heaven’s grace and felt a wave; the Lord says the heavens have opened again, as green light rises over jade.
Choi Minwoo commands Hunters sheltering underground in the desert; thousands of enemies are approaching, and he has chosen to lead the group into battle.
The Skeleton King is with Choi Minwoo’s group, whose Hunters are ready to follow his command.
open_questions: What caused the wave that the Grand Mage felt and the Lord of Heaven acknowledged?
What does the Lord of Heaven mean when he says the heavens have opened again?
What danger awaits the coalition army at Tianshan?
Who are the thousands of enemies approaching Choi Minwoo’s shelter, and what are they pursuing?
Who speaks the unexpected line, “Dad’s not sleeping”?
temporary_decisions: Render 仙界 as “realm of immortals.”
Render 塔克拉玛干 as “Taklamakan Desert.”
Render 汗血寶馬 as “sweat-blood horse.”
Render 스켈레톤 킹 as “Skeleton King” and 방공호 as “bomb shelter.”
